title: Graph Folder-Scoped Source Resolution
summary: Extends ConstructionGraphResolver to dispatch all five Phase 02 canonical scopes (sharepoint_project_drive_folder, sharepoint_site_page, onedrive_business_root, onedrive_personal_root, onedrive_shared_library) plus the two legacy scopes that map onto the new handlers (sharepoint_library, onedrive_shared). Adds folder-scoped delta endpoint selection (_select_delta_endpoint) so sharepoint_project_drive_folder sources crawl /drives/{drive_id}/items/{folder_item_id}/delta when folder_item_id is present, with documented fallback to drive-root + filter when only drive_id is available. Site-page sources cleanly exit with status='skipped_unsupported_scope' (delta is not the right primitive for page traversal). CrawlReceipt gains scope, endpoint_kind, folder_item_id; ResolutionResult gains folder_item_id, page_id, scope, note, pre_resolved. Canonical pre-populated identifiers fast-path to pre_resolved without any Graph HTTP call. CLI graph sources resolve summary now includes by_scope counter and pre_resolved bucket. No live Graph round-trip; no V5 store writes; no CLI breaking changes.
